【原视频简介】
Step inside an enormous modern coconut candy factory to see how fresh, tropical coconuts are transformed into delicious, colorful, and chewy candies. In this exclusive tour by Global Export Factory, we take you deep behind the scenes of a high-tech coconut candy factory to witness the entire production process from raw ingredients to final export. 🌴🍬

The journey begins in the receiving area where mature coconuts are sorted and washed. After extracting the rich coconut milk, it is combined with sugar and syrup in massive cooking kettles. Watch how the automated machinery in this state-of-the-art coconut candy factory splits the warm mixture into six mouthwatering flavors including original, pandan, cacao, coffee, durian, and taro. From cooling and precise cutting to color-coded individual wrapping and automated pouch packaging, every single step in this coconut candy factory is designed for maximum quality, cleanliness, and efficiency. Finally, the finished cartons are palletized and loaded onto cargo trucks for global distribution. 📦🚛

If you enjoy watching automated food manufacturing and industrial scale factory tours, please subscribe to Global Export Factory and click the notification bell so you never miss our next exciting video. 🔔👍
